scope: Reset initial native focus and owned full Log commit picker; full app/ChooseVersion parity incomplete.

verification.source: ResetDlg InitChooseVersion() does not request combo focus and sets focus to selected Reset type. ChooseVersion commit browse uses Log SetParams with typed revision as highlight/range, selection and single-selection enabled, and working-tree changes hidden.
verification.focus: Final hidden native Reset receiver passes both Git engines: chosen Soft/Mixed/Hard button is actual first responder and selected/enabled after loading, mode changes retain current responder without another handoff, close invalidates focus. Real empty bare fixture focuses Soft and disables Mixed. No physical key/checkbox/tab/arrow interaction is claimed.
verification.picker: Real owned Log controller in single-selection mode loads typed prior revision ancestry; excludes newer HEAD and sibling branch commits, suppresses working-tree row, retains model graph rows and initial typed-revision selection. Actual HistoryTableView has expected rows and disallows multiple selection. Accept returns full selected hash despite close-before-result ordering; Cancel preserves draft. Stale/late results, rejected presentation, inactive target, duplicate/cross-route/reset/apply/close/Quit and forced parent cleanup are checked. HEAD/staged tree/config unchanged after setup.
verification.selection_regression: Ordinary Log and explicit multiple-selection Log tables retain native multiple selection. Setter also updates when a table receives a different model/mode; model replacement itself is not separately exercised here.
verification.modified_files_regression: Existing owned Changed Files receiver passes both engines against current source: tracked mixed/staged/unstaged/add/delete/Unicode paths, exclusions, selected target preservation, parent/reset/apply/close/Quit gates and owned child lifecycle; HEAD/staged tree/config/working bytes unchanged.
verification.presentation_diagnostic: Synthetic presenters originally retained native keyboard focus in the disabled parent: 176 AttributeGraph cycle warnings in each combined two-engine Log-picker and modified-files run. With identical product source and assertions, injected presenters release parent focus via makeFirstResponder(nil): final Log-picker and modified-files runs both pass and emit zero cycles. This supports an injected-presentation cause; physical AppKit sheet transfer/restoration remains unverified. Source focus bookkeeping is non-published and radio selection remains bound, avoiding needless publications.
verification.repairs: Initial Debug failure was Swift memberwise argument order for new LogDialog column-autosave option, corrected. Initial receiver failed to locate SwiftUI commit field by placeholder accessibility label; corrected to actual field text. Failed and diagnostic logs retained locally; throwing exits clean owned windows/preferences/fixtures.
verification.debug: Final unsigned Debug build and bundle audit pass.
verification.store: Final unsigned AppStore build and required bundle audit pass: bundled universal Git 2.55.0, Git LFS 3.8.0, Finder extension, all 99 original icons and EditorConfig/IssueRegex runtimes.
verification.notice: Both bundled NOTICE files byte-equal source.
verification.inventory: Pinned inventory checker passes; Reset and ChooseVersion mappings remain partial.
verification.site: Local GitHub Pages rebuild passes; no new physical captures or deployment.

limitations: Injected presenters release parent focus and never order windows or show real sheets. Actual sheet focus/default buttons/keyboard/arrow groups, error recovery, close while loading, visual/theme/accessibility and signed security-scope acceptance remain pending.
Full BrowseRefs all-reference tree/reload, history combos, chooser integration in other dialogs and full Log/FileDiff command parity remain unfinished.
No new physical screenshots or site deployment. Unsigned packaging does not prove App Store acceptance, signing or Finder activation; whole port and hosted CI remain incomplete.

cleanup.windows: Owned native windows unordered and activation prohibited; column autosave disabled in test Log hosts, private suites removed on throwing/normal exits. No general pasteboard writes. All native/compiler/build handles terminal.
